reuse.why: Consolidates the five provider link copies into one linkBankSyncAccount that the new Fintegra link also uses, and reuses link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and handleSyncResponse; the unlink reset and the Fintegra download are written again rather than shared.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with only the server key changed, the replace branch copies unlinkAccount's field reset, and the holder query repeats the SQL of assertBankAccountNotLinked.

placement.why: Link logic stays in server/accounts/app.ts, sync download in sync.ts, provider type in types/models and server URL in server-config, following the tree's layout.

scope.why: All edits serve the five steps (refactor, uniqueness, Fintegra, closed accounts, replace), with only the needed client registrations for the new provider.

maintainability.why: One link path with explicit syncedTables/fileId variations is easy to own; the copied download function and unlink reset will drift, and the assert call is repeated in each wrapper instead of living in linkBankSyncAccount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount clears the previous holder with its own db.updateAccount block instead of sharing the local-unlink step of unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated blocks (Fintegra download, unlink reset, holder query) are plain copies, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: replaceExistingLink added to linkBankSyncAccount and assertBankAccountNotLinked; a replace-holder branch inside linkBankSyncAccount and the `existing && !replaceExistingLink` exception in the assertion; all six provider links go through the helper.
